stem.text: A pipe, closed at one end, has a loudspeaker at the open end. For some frequencies of sound from the loudspeaker, a stationary sound wave is formed in the air within the pipe with an antinode at the open end of the pipe.

stem.alt: Loudspeaker at one end of a pipe, with a double-headed arrow above the pipe marked 0.85 m and the label pipe.

stem.text: The length of the pipe is $0.85\,\text{m}$.
The speed of sound in air is $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
Which frequency of sound from the loudspeaker would **not** produce a stationary wave?
